an3.25:2.3: This is in reference to the experience of stream-entry. This vision of the four noble truths occurs in a flash that is unmistakable and unforgettable. The nature of the world is revealed in all its clarity. Yet the stream-enterer still has fetters, so their direct vision of the truth is transitory. But like a person wandering in the dark, who all of a sudden sees what is around them revealed by lightning, they never go back to the same level of ignorance. The word for lighting (_vijju_) is similar to knowledge (_vijjā_), albeit from a different root.
